pages.text: Julia and Toby sit next to the play house. It is dusk.
pages.picture: girl and dragon by the playhouse at dusk

pages.text: "Toby, tell me about your home," said Julia.
pages.picture: the girl leaning in to listen

pages.text: Toby looks up at Super-Tall Peak. "My mum is up there," he said. "I miss her."
pages.picture: the dragon gazing at a far mountain in the sunset

pages.text: A tear drips down his nose. He is sad.
pages.picture: a tear on the dragon's nose

pages.text: And then Julia feels her feet lift off the grass. Just a bit. Then a bit higher.
pages.picture: the girl's feet lifting off the grass

pages.text: Julia is floating! She drifts and bobs, soft as a cloud.
pages.picture: the girl floating gently in the air, arms out

pages.text: "Toby! Look at me!" she said. "I am floating! This is the best!"
Toby grins. And, bump, Julia sinks back down.
pages.picture: the girl bumping down onto the grass, the dragon grinning

pages.text: "Toby!" said Julia. "When you are sad, I float. When you are glad, I sink. That is not fair!"
pages.picture: the girl on the grass, pretending to be cross, both laughing

pages.text: Far away, on top of Super-Tall Peak, a big dragon is looking for Toby.
pages.picture: a large dragon on the mountaintop, looking out over the land
